Title: More ways to purchase Azure Multi-Factor Authentication

Body.Content: Azure Multi-Factor Authentication can now be purchased through Volume Licensing, the Cloud Solution Provider program, Azure in Open, or Azure Direct as an annual user-based model—like Microsoft Azure Active Directory Premium, Microsoft Intune, and Azure Rights Management. This new user option does not bill against Azure monetary commitment. We continue to offer user- and authentication-based consumption offers that will bill against Azure monetary commitment. This new offer includes the same feature set as the existing offerings—it’s just a different way to purchase Multi-Factor Authentication, which better aligns with how Office 365 and Azure Active Directory Basic and Premium are purchased. Multi-Factor Authentication will continue to be included as part of Azure Active Directory Premium, Microsoft Enterprise Mobility Suite, and Enterprise Cloud Suite. For more information about the versions and features available, please visit the "Available versions of Azure Multi-Factor Authentication" section of the How Azure Multi-Factor Authentication works documentation page.
Body.Markdown:
Azure Multi-Factor Authentication can now be purchased through Volume Licensing, the Cloud Solution Provider program, Azure in Open, or Azure Direct as an annual user-based model—like Microsoft Azure Active Directory Premium, Microsoft Intune, and Azure Rights Management. This new user option does not bill against Azure monetary commitment. We continue to offer user- and authentication-based consumption offers that will bill against Azure monetary commitment.

This new offer includes the same feature set as the existing offerings—it’s just a different way to purchase Multi-Factor Authentication, which better aligns with how Office 365 and Azure Active Directory Basic and Premium are purchased.

Multi-Factor Authentication will continue to be included as part of Azure Active Directory Premium, Microsoft Enterprise Mobility Suite, and Enterprise Cloud Suite.

For more information about the versions and features available, please visit the "Available versions of Azure Multi-Factor Authentication" section of the How Azure Multi-Factor Authentication works documentation page.
